meta.scope: Every Grok batch file for Iraq merged into one file. Records are byte-faithful to the batches except for the normalisations listed in _consolidation.

reports.title: Central Statistical Organization (Iraq) institutional core
reports.publisher: Central Statistical Organization
reports.description: Primary national statistical office responsible for censuses, surveys, national accounts, prices, labour, demographic and multi-domain socio-economic statistics.
reports._notes: Foundational institutional node for the Iraqi statistical system.

reports.title: Population census and estimates
reports.publisher: Central Statistical Organization / related
reports.description: Official population census and estimates. Population is approximately 47–48 million; the age structure is young and urbanisation is advancing.
reports._notes: Core demographic node. Population ~47–48 million.
reports._url_evidence: CSO 'تقديرات السكان' page lists Iraq population estimate reports (2015-2018, 2019, 2020, 2021) and the 2023 demographic composition report.

reports.title: National Accounts of Iraq (GDP)
reports.publisher: Central Statistical Organization / related
reports.description: Official national accounts (GDP). The economy is heavily oil-dominated; non-oil activity and public-sector employment are central to domestic absorption.
reports._notes: Primary macroeconomic output node. Oil share is structurally dominant.
reports._url_evidence: CSO 'الدخل القومي والناتج المحلي الاجمالي' page lists annual preliminary/actual GDP and national income estimate reports 2014-2025 plus quarterly GDP estimates.

reports.title: Consumer Price Index and inflation statistics
reports.publisher: Central Statistical Organization
reports.description: CPI and inflation rates. Inflation has been relatively moderate in recent periods compared with some regional peers, but remains sensitive to exchange-rate and supply conditions.
reports._notes: Core high-frequency price node.
reports._url_evidence: CSO consumer price index page lists monthly and annual CPI/inflation reports from 2016 through mid-2026 with Excel tables and metadata.

reports.title: Central Bank of Iraq institutional and reporting core
reports.publisher: Central Bank of Iraq
reports.description: Central bank responsible for monetary policy, foreign-exchange management, reserve management and key macro-financial and external statistics. Publishes monetary, banking, exchange-rate, BOP and related series.
reports._notes: Central-bank institutional counterpart to the statistical office.

reports.title: Balance of Payments and external accounts
reports.publisher: Central Bank of Iraq
reports.description: BOP and external-sector statistics. Oil exports dominate the current account; reserve management and FX windows are central policy instruments.
reports._notes: External-accounts node under oil-export dominance.
reports._url_evidence: CBI 'بيانات ميزان المدفوعات' page lists annual balance of payments datasets 2000-2025 plus quarterly external-sector data in standard format.

reports.title: Iraq foundational statistical-system meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from CSO and CBI sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding the CSO institutional core, population, national accounts, CPI, CBI institutional role and BOP into the opening foundation layer for Iraqi research.
reports._notes: Opening integrating node for Iraqi research. Oil dominance will structure subsequent densification.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch

reports.title: Crude oil production statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of Oil / related
reports.description: Official and compiled statistics on crude oil production. Production is in the mid-to-high 4 million barrels per day range in recent readings; federal and Kurdistan Region output are distinguished in detailed monitoring.
reports._notes: Core real-sector production node. Highest-centrality commodity for Iraq.
reports._url_evidence: OPEC's Iraq member-country page gives Iraq crude oil production (4,453 tb/d), proven reserves and exports; the Iraqi Ministry of Oil domain (oil.gov.iq) returns 403 and is unreachable via WebFetch.

reports.title: Crude oil export statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of Oil
reports.description: Official statistics on crude oil export volumes and values from southern terminals and other outlets. Oil exports dominate merchandise exports and current-account credits.
reports._notes: Primary external-earnings node.
reports._url_evidence: SOMO (State Organization for Marketing of Oil, Ministry of Oil) 'صادرات النفط الخام' page lists monthly crude export data files (Dec 2025 - Jun 2026) and the 2025 annual export summary.

reports.title: Oil revenue and fiscal dependence statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of Finance / Ministry of Oil related
reports.description: Statistics on oil revenues as a share of total federal budget revenue. Oil typically accounts for the large majority of public revenue (recent readings around 84% in early 2026), making the fiscal position highly sensitive to oil prices and export volumes.
reports._notes: Core fiscal-oil nexus node.

reports.title: Federal budget revenue and expenditure statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of Finance
reports.description: Official federal budget realization covering revenues (oil and non-oil), expenditures and the overall balance. Public-sector salaries, pensions and social allocations form a large recurrent share of spending.
reports._notes: Core fiscal-flow node under oil dominance.
reports._url_evidence: Iraqi Ministry of Finance Budget Archive page lists federal budget documents by year (2010-2024).

reports.title: Iraq oil–fiscal densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from Oil Ministry and Finance Ministry sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding crude oil production, oil exports, oil-revenue fiscal dependence and federal budget statistics into a coherent oil–fiscal layer that dominates the Iraqi macro structure.
reports._notes: Integrating node for the oil–fiscal densification pass.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
National accounts, BOP and CBI series from Batch 1

reports.title: Kurdistan Region oil production and revenue framing
reports.publisher: Derived from KRG and federal monitoring sources
reports.description: Statistics and framing of oil production and sales in the Kurdistan Region. Production has typically been in the 250–350 thousand barrels per day range in recent years; sales arrangements, pricing differentials and federal–KRG revenue sharing are recurring points of contention.
reports._notes: Primary subnational oil densification. Complements federal oil nodes.
_referenced_by: Federal oil production and export statistics

reports.title: Public-sector wage bill and employment statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of Finance / related
reports.description: Statistics on public-sector salaries, pensions and related recurrent expenditure. The wage bill absorbs a very large share of federal spending and is a central fiscal pressure point under oil-revenue volatility.
reports._notes: High-centrality fiscal-expenditure node under oil dependence.
_referenced_by: Oil revenue and fiscal sustainability analysis

reports.title: Exchange-rate and dinar statistics
reports.publisher: Central Bank of Iraq
reports.description: Official exchange rate for the Iraqi dinar and related FX window operations. The official rate is the central policy price; parallel or informal market premia appear periodically under liquidity or compliance pressures.
reports._notes: Critical price and external-management node.
reports._url_evidence: CBI exchange-rates page lists daily/monthly/annual Iraqi dinar rates against the US dollar and other currencies (1995-2026).

reports.title: Iraq KRG–wage–exchange densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from oil, fiscal and CBI sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding Kurdistan Region oil framing, public-sector wage bill statistics and exchange-rate/dinar statistics into a coherent subnational–fiscal–monetary layer.
reports._notes: Integrating node for Batch 3 domains.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Oil production, exports, federal budget and BOP series from earlier batches

reports.title: Banking system structure and credit statistics
reports.publisher: Central Bank of Iraq
reports.description: Statistics on the structure of the banking system, total assets, credit aggregates and related indicators. State-owned banks dominate; private-sector credit depth remains limited relative to the size of the oil economy.
reports._notes: Core banking-system structural node.
reports._url_evidence: CBI 'النشرة الإحصائية الشهرية' (Monthly Statistical Bulletin) page, the CBI's monetary and banking statistics release including bank balance-sheet and credit aggregates.

reports.title: Non-performing loans and banking asset-quality statistics
reports.publisher: CBI / World Bank-aligned
reports.description: System-wide non-performing loan ratios. NPL ratios have been elevated (mid-teens percent range in recent compilations), reflecting legacy asset-quality issues and limited private-sector credit resolution.
reports._notes: Core asset-quality / risk node for the banking cluster.
reports._url_evidence: CBI Financial Soundness Indicators page lists FSI reports (2015-2019, 2020, 2021, 2024 first issue), the CBI series carrying NPL and asset-quality ratios.

reports.title: Labour force and unemployment statistics
reports.publisher: Derived from national and World Bank-aligned sources
reports.description: Labour-force participation and unemployment rates. Unemployment is elevated (mid-teens percent range in recent estimates); female and youth rates are substantially higher. Public-sector employment absorbs a large share of formal jobs.
reports._notes: Primary labour-market node. Links tightly to the public wage bill.
reports._url_evidence: ILO publication page for the Iraq Labour Force Survey 2021, produced with Iraq's CSO and the Kurdistan Region Statistics Office, covering employment, unemployment and labour underutilisation.

reports.title: Reconstruction and development investment framing
reports.publisher: Derived from government and international financial institution sources
reports.description: Policy and investment framing of post-conflict reconstruction, infrastructure rehabilitation and development projects (transport, energy, social services). Continuously cited in fiscal, donor and spatial analysis.
reports._notes: High-level reconstruction densification.

reports.title: Iraq banking–labour–reconstruction densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from CBI, labour and development sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding banking system structure, NPL statistics, labour force and unemployment, and reconstruction framing into a coherent financial–labour–development layer.
reports._notes: Integrating node for Batch 4 domains.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Wage bill, oil, fiscal and CBI series from earlier batches

reports.title: Baghdad governorate economic and fiscal framing
reports.publisher: Derived from fiscal and statistical sources
reports.description: Framing of Baghdad as the capital and dominant administrative, services and fiscal centre. Frequently ranks first in total provincial budget allocations and concentrates headquarters, public employment and services activity.
reports._notes: Primary capital-region densification.

reports.title: Basra governorate economic and oil framing
reports.publisher: Derived from oil and fiscal sources
reports.description: Framing of Basra as the principal southern oil and export hub. Hosts the bulk of federal crude production and export terminals; high fiscal importance and recurrent demands for local resource shares.
reports._notes: Primary southern oil-province densification.

reports.title: Erbil governorate / Kurdistan Region economic framing
reports.publisher: Derived from KRG and federal sources
reports.description: Framing of Erbil as the political and commercial centre of the Kurdistan Region. Complements the KRG oil framing with services, trade and administrative activity.
reports._notes: Primary Kurdistan Region urban densification.

reports.title: Governorate and spatial structure framing
reports.publisher: Derived from fiscal and statistical sources
reports.description: System-level view of Iraq’s governorate structure: oil-producing south (Basra and peers), capital concentration (Baghdad), Kurdistan Region autonomy, and lagging or conflict-affected governorates. Continuously cited in fiscal equalisation, reconstruction and disparity analysis.
reports._notes: Spatial densification frame for the dual federal–KRG and oil–non-oil structure.
_referenced_by: Federal budget and oil revenue statistics

reports.title: Iraq provincial densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from fiscal and spatial sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding Baghdad, Basra, Erbil and governorate-structure framing into a coherent provincial densification layer that complements the oil–fiscal and KRG cores.
reports._notes: Integrating node for the provincial densification pass.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Oil, KRG, wage-bill and reconstruction series from earlier batches

reports.title: Iraq–China merchandise trade and cooperation framing
reports.publisher: Derived from trade and bilateral sources
reports.description: Bilateral trade and economic cooperation with China. China is a major destination for Iraqi crude and a large source of imports (machinery, equipment, consumer goods) and infrastructure investment interest.
reports._notes: Primary Asian bilateral densification.

reports.title: Iraq–Turkey merchandise trade statistics
reports.publisher: Derived from Turkish and Iraqi trade sources
reports.description: Bilateral trade with Turkey. Turkey is a major source of Iraqi imports (food, construction materials, consumer goods, jewellery) and a destination for some refined products and transit; volumes are large and sensitive to border and security conditions.
reports._notes: Primary regional bilateral trade densification.

reports.title: Iraq external economic cooperation framing
reports.publisher: Ministry of Finance / related
reports.description: System-level framing of Iraq’s network of joint economic commissions, bilateral cooperation agreements and preferential arrangements. Continuously cited in trade diversification, investment and reconstruction analysis.
reports._notes: Overall external-architecture densification beyond pure oil exports.

reports.title: Iraq external-partners densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from trade and cooperation sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding Iraq–China trade/cooperation, Iraq–Turkey trade, and broader external economic cooperation framing into a coherent external-partners layer.
reports._notes: Integrating node for the external densification pass.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Oil exports, BOP and reconstruction series from earlier batches

reports.title: Poverty and living standards statistics
reports.publisher: Derived from World Bank-aligned and national monitoring sources
reports.description: Poverty rates and living-standards indicators. Security and living conditions have improved relative to peak-conflict years; poverty reduction has been accompanied by gains in asset ownership and public-service access, though labour-force participation remains low, especially for women.
reports._notes: Core welfare measurement node.
reports._url_evidence: CSO 'احوال المعيشة' page lists the Iraq Poverty Monitoring and Assessment Survey 2017-2018 and the continuous socio-economic survey.

reports.title: Education enrolment and completion statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of Education / UNESCO-aligned
reports.description: Statistics and estimates on primary and secondary completion and enrolment. Primary completion has risen substantially; upper-secondary completion remains more limited. Kurdistan Region operates a distinct education administration.
reports._notes: Core education access and human-capital node.
reports._url_evidence: CSO 'التربية والتعليم' page lists annual education statistics reports (kindergarten, primary, secondary, vocational, university) for roughly 2014-2024 with Excel tables.

reports.title: Life expectancy and health outcome statistics
reports.publisher: WHO / national sources
reports.description: Life expectancy at birth and related health indicators. Continuously referenced in human-development and post-conflict recovery analysis.
reports._notes: Core health-outcome densification.
reports._url_evidence: WHO country health data page for Iraq showing life expectancy at birth, healthy life expectancy and mortality/health-system indicators.

reports.title: Greenhouse gas emissions statistics
reports.publisher: Derived from international compilations
reports.description: National GHG emissions estimates. Energy and oil-related activities dominate the emissions profile; the series is referenced in climate and energy-transition discussions.
reports._notes: Core climate-measurement node under oil dominance.

reports.title: Iraq social–climate densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from welfare, education, health and climate sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding poverty and living standards, education enrolment/completion, life expectancy, and GHG emissions into a coherent social and climate residual layer.
reports._notes: Integrating node for Batch 7 domains.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Labour, wage-bill, oil and reconstruction series from earlier batches

reports.title: Agriculture production statistics
reports.publisher: Derived from national and USDA-aligned sources
reports.description: Statistics on major crop production. Wheat and barley are the principal cereals; production is sensitive to water availability, conflict disruption and input constraints. Agriculture remains important for rural livelihoods and food security despite oil dominance.
reports._notes: Core primary-sector production node under oil dominance.
reports._url_evidence: CSO agricultural statistics section describing its annual crop, vegetable, fruit and livestock production surveys, with sub-sections for temporary crops, permanent crops, livestock and the agricultural census.

reports.title: Wheat production statistics
reports.publisher: Derived from agricultural monitoring sources
reports.description: Focused statistics on wheat production. Wheat is the dominant cereal; recent seasons have shown recovery in output relative to drought- and conflict-affected years.
reports._notes: Foundational food-security crop densification.
reports._url_evidence: CSO temporary-crops page lists the annual 'تقرير الحنطة والشعير' (wheat and barley) production reports for 2016-2025 with accompanying Excel tables.

reports.title: Electricity generation and capacity statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of Electricity / related
reports.description: Installed generation capacity and electricity production statistics. Capacity is in the high-30s GW range; generation relies heavily on gas and thermal plants, with chronic shortfalls relative to peak demand and fuel/availability constraints.
reports._notes: Core power-system statistical product. Chronic reliability issues are a structural feature.
reports._url_evidence: CSO 'مشاريع الماء والكهرباء' page lists annual electricity project statistics reports 2015-2024, noting the data come from the Ministry of Electricity's information centre.

reports.title: Defence and security expenditure statistics
reports.publisher: Derived from budget and international compilations
reports.description: Statistics on defence and security spending. Continuously referenced in fiscal, security and post-conflict analysis; security-related outlays form a material share of the federal budget alongside the wage bill.
reports._notes: Core defence-resource node.

reports.title: Iraq agriculture–power–defence densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from agricultural, electricity and security sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding agriculture and wheat statistics, electricity generation/capacity, and defence/security expenditure into a coherent primary–energy–security residual layer.
reports._notes: Integrating node for Batch 8 domains.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Oil, fiscal, reconstruction and poverty series from earlier batches

reports.title: Water storage and Tigris-Euphrates basin statistics
reports.publisher: Derived from national and UN monitoring sources
reports.description: Statistics and monitoring on live water storage, reservoir levels and basin inflows. Iraq has experienced severe storage declines and recurrent drought; recent recovery episodes remain partial relative to long-term capacity. Upstream flows and transboundary arrangements are structural constraints.
reports._notes: High-centrality environmental constraint node linking agriculture, climate and food security.
reports._url_evidence: CSO water resources page lists the annual 'تقارير الموارد المائية' reports 2015-2020 with Excel data tables.

reports.title: Non-oil economic structure framing
reports.publisher: Derived from national accounts and sector sources
reports.description: Analytical framing of the non-oil economy: manufacturing, construction, trade, transport, agriculture and public services. Non-oil activity is material for employment and domestic absorption but remains secondary to oil in value added and fiscal contribution.
reports._notes: System-level counterpart to the oil-dominated core.

reports.title: Iraq residual densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from water and structural sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding water storage / Tigris-Euphrates statistics and non-oil economic structure framing into a coherent residual environmental and structural layer.
reports._notes: Integrating node for the final residual densification pass.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Agriculture, climate, oil and national accounts series from earlier batches

_consolidation.json_syntax_repair_note: These batch files were not valid JSON as delivered: "releases_per_year" carried an unquoted text value (missing opening quote), e.g. `"releases_per_year": continuous",`. Repaired mechanically by re-quoting the value verbatim. No number was invented.
_consolidation.cadence_note: A non-numeric cadence text was moved off releases_per_year into _cadence_original verbatim and the numeric field omitted, per the v2 spec (omitted, never null). Needs a human/judgement pass to become a real number.

_normalisation.note: Second pass, 2026-08-18: mechanical alignment to src/lib/types.ts. Nothing researched, nothing invented. Every original value that was replaced is preserved on the record under a key prefixed with an underscore.
rules: jurisdiction_level mapped into the six-value union; the delivered string kept as _jurisdiction_level_original.
domains: format-normalised, then any tag outside the 22 approved values prefixed "proposed:" as the spec directs. No semantic merging was done — that needs your call.

relationship_type: part_of edges moved onto the child node as part_of; contains edges reversed onto the child; produced_by edges dropped (publisher is a string, not a node); related_to / complements held in _dropped as deferred. Off-union values were poisoning every PageRank score with NaN.
last_updated added as null where absent (required field, string|null).
region filled with the country name where it was null or missing.
releases_per_year: unambiguous single-word cadences resolved to numbers; ambiguous text left in _cadence_original and listed under _gaps.unresolved_cadence.
source_kind mapped to official/commercial; delivered value kept as _source_kind_original.
Non-schema keys Grok wrote (shape, notes, referenced_by, ...) renamed with a leading underscore so they are visibly not part of the schema. Nothing deleted.

_gaps.note: What is genuinely missing and cannot be fixed mechanically — this is the research queue, not a defect list.

url_research_pass.method: Per-country web research. A URL was accepted only when the page was actually retrieved and its content confirmed the publication. Publisher homepages, Wikipedia, news, aggregators and mirrors were rejected. Confirmations are stored on each node as _url_evidence.

_gaps.not_a_publication_note: These 21 nodes were checked against the web and are not published documents — synthesised 'meta'/'framing' nodes that only bind other nodes together, geographic areas, industries, projects, or institutions. The data spec (2b/2c) bans all of these. They are flagged in place with _flagged_not_a_publication rather than deleted, so you can strip them in one pass once you agree. 0 dependency edges in this file touch one.
